newsitem.title: CANADA: Canarc receives initial Indonesian COWs.
newsitem.headline: Canarc receives initial Indonesian COWs.

text.p: Canarc Resource Corp said on Wednesday it has received 12 initial contracts of work from the Indonesian government to work in Kalimantan on the island of Borneo.

Canarc said in a statement it has now secured its title to the mineral rights on the 12 properties. The company said the contracts will now be forwarded to the Indonesian Parliament as a matter of course.
Canarc also said it has received receipts for SIPPs or work permits on all 12 properties.
The director general of mines has indicated the work permits and the release of "seriousness bond" funds of US$10 million will be forwarded to Canarc in the next few weeks, Canarc said.
A 13th contract of work is still pending final government approval for an increased land holding over the original application, the company said.
